title: Past continuous and past simple
summary: Past continuous и past simple: фон и событие, последовательность и параллельность, завершённость действия, вежливые формы (I was wondering), привычки с always и планы, увиденные из прошлого.
ru:
## Фон и событие
Главная идея: **past continuous** рисует **фон** — то, что происходило вокруг, а **past simple** выводит на передний план **событие**, которое двигает рассказ вперёд.
> It was getting dark, and the street was empty. A car stopped outside the hotel. — Темнело, улица была пуста. У отеля остановилась машина.
> I was crossing the bridge when my phone rang. — Я переходил мост, когда зазвонил телефон. (переход — длинное действие, звонок — короткое)
Длинное действие может быть **прервано** (**was cooking ... when the lights went out**) или **длиться параллельно** с другим длинным действием (**While I was cooking, he was setting the table**).

## Последовательность или одновременность?
Если два действия **следуют друг за другом**, оба идут в past simple. Если одно уже шло, когда началось другое, — continuous.
> When I opened the door, the dog barked. — Когда я открыл дверь, собака залаяла. (сначала дверь, потом лай)
> When I opened the door, the dog was barking. — Когда я открыл дверь, собака уже лаяла. (лай шёл и до того)
Эта разница часто решает смысл фразы: **When the teacher came in, the students stood up** (встали в ответ) и **...the students were standing up** (уже поднимались).

## Завершённое или незавершённое
Past simple обычно говорит о **завершённом** действии, past continuous — о процессе, **результат которого неизвестен**.
> I wrote the report yesterday afternoon. — Я написал отчёт вчера днём. (готов)
> I was writing the report yesterday afternoon. — Вчера днём я писал отчёт. (был занят; закончил ли — неизвестно)
> She painted the fence. / She was painting the fence. — Забор покрашен целиком / она красила забор.
Поэтому **I was reading a novel on the plane** — просто процесс, а **I read a novel on the plane** — прочитал целиком.

## Глаголы состояния и повторяемость
Глаголы состояния (**know, believe, want, like, belong, need**) в past continuous обычно не используются: **I knew the answer** — ~~I was knowing the answer~~. Для повторяющихся действий используем past simple (**Every Monday she visited her aunt**), а **was always doing** означает раздражение или удивление: **He was always leaving the door open.** — Он вечно оставлял дверь открытой.

## Вежливость и «планы в прошлом»
Past continuous звучит мягче и вежливее, чем настоящее: **I was wondering if you could help me. / I was hoping we could talk.** Оно может описывать и **запланированное событие, которое ещё не случилось** с точки зрения прошлого: **She was leaving for Berlin the next morning, so she was packing.**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I was seeing a strange light last night.~~ → I **saw** a strange light.
- ~~When I arrived, they had dinner.~~ (если они уже ели) → ...they **were having** dinner.
- ~~While I walked to work, it started to rain.~~ → While I **was walking** to work, it started to rain.
- ~~I was knowing him at school.~~ → I **knew** him at school.
en:
## Background and event
The key idea: **past continuous** paints the **background** - what was going on around - while **past simple** brings forward the **event** that moves the story on.
> It was getting dark, and the street was empty. A car stopped outside the hotel.
> I was crossing the bridge when my phone rang. (crossing is the longer action, the ring is short)
A long action can be **interrupted** (**was cooking ... when the lights went out**) or can **run in parallel** with another long action (**While I was cooking, he was setting the table**).

## Sequence or simultaneity?
When two actions **follow one another**, both go in past simple. If one was already going on when the other began, we use continuous.
> When I opened the door, the dog barked. (first the door, then the bark)
> When I opened the door, the dog was barking. (it had been barking before)
This difference often changes the meaning: **When the teacher came in, the students stood up** (as a reaction) and **...the students were standing up** (they were already rising).

## Finished or unfinished
Past simple usually tells us the action was **completed**; past continuous shows a process whose **result is not stated**.
> I wrote the report yesterday afternoon. (it is done)
> I was writing the report yesterday afternoon. (I was busy with it; maybe I did not finish)
> She painted the fence. / She was painting the fence. (the whole fence / she was in the middle of it)
So **I was reading a novel on the plane** just describes the activity, but **I read a novel on the plane** means I finished it.

## State verbs and repetition
State verbs (**know, believe, want, like, belong, need**) are normally not used in past continuous: **I knew the answer** - ~~I was knowing the answer~~. Repeated actions usually go in past simple (**Every Monday she visited her aunt**), but **was always doing** shows annoyance or surprise: **He was always leaving the door open.**

## Politeness and plans seen from the past
Past continuous sounds softer and more polite than the present: **I was wondering if you could help me. / I was hoping we could talk.** It can also describe **a planned future event seen from the past**: **She was leaving for Berlin the next morning, so she was packing.**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I was seeing a strange light last night.~~ → I **saw** a strange light.
- ~~When I arrived, they had dinner.~~ (if they were already eating) → ...they **were having** dinner.
- ~~While I walked to work, it started to rain.~~ → While I **was walking** to work, it started to rain.
- ~~I was knowing him at school.~~ → I **knew** him at school.
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| Past simple | I worked. | I didn't work. | Did you work? |
| Past continuous | I was working. | I wasn't working. | Were you working? |

## Формулы
> **was/were + V-ing** (фон) + **when** + past simple (событие)
> We were having lunch when the news arrived.

> **While** + past continuous, past simple
> While she was crossing the road, a cyclist hit her.

> past simple + and + past simple (последовательность)
> He opened the file and read the first line.

## Сравнительная таблица
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Фон | past continuous | The sun was setting. |
| Событие | past simple | A bird landed on the roof. |
| Прерванное действие | continuous + simple | I was driving when it began to snow. |
| Одновременность | continuous + continuous | She was typing while he was reading. |
| Последовательность | simple + simple | When she smiled, he relaxed. |
| Незавершённость | past continuous | I was painting the wall. |
| Завершённость | past simple | I painted the wall. |
| Вежливость | past continuous | I was wondering if you could... |
| Раздражение | was always + V-ing | He was always interrupting. |

exercises.title: Past simple или past continuous?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глаголы в past simple или past continuous.
exercises.example: I (cook) dinner when the lights (go out). → I was cooking dinner when the lights went out.

items.text: When the fire alarm {{went off}}, we {{were sitting}} in the canteen.
I {{was cooking}} dinner when the lights {{went out}}.
As soon as the manager {{walked}} in, everyone {{stopped}} talking.
While Lena {{was studying}} in Vienna, she {{met}} her future husband.
I {{didn't recognise|didn't recognize|did not recognise|did not recognize}} him; he {{was wearing}} a hat and sunglasses.
What {{were you doing}} at nine o'clock last night? I called you twice.
It {{was raining}} heavily, so we {{decided}} to stay in.
Mark {{was always losing}} his phone when we shared a flat.

exercises.title: Вежливость, планы, фон
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глаголы в past simple или past continuous.

items.text: I {{was wondering|wondered}} if you could help me with this form.
She {{was just leaving|was leaving}} when the phone rang.
When I {{got}} home, the children {{were watching}} TV.
The pilot {{was flying}} over the Alps when the engine {{failed}}.
We {{were driving}} through the mountains when we {{saw}} a bear.
Dana {{was leaving}} for Rome the next morning, so she {{packed}} that night.
At this time last year I {{was living|lived}} in Prague.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: I ___ along the river when I met Tony.
items.why: Длинное действие прервано коротким событием — **was walking**.

items.q: When Paula opened the door, the cat ___ out immediately.
items.why: Одно действие следует за другим (**immediately**) — **past simple**.

items.q: While I ___ the bill, someone stole my bag.
items.why: Процесс, во время которого произошло событие — **was paying**.

items.q: At 7 a.m. yesterday the whole family ___ breakfast.
items.why: Процесс в конкретный момент — **were having**; **had** означало бы, что они сели за стол в 7:00.

items.q: Sorry to disturb you. I ___ if I could borrow your car.
items.why: Вежливая просьба — **I was wondering**; с I нужно **was**.

items.q: Yesterday I ___ a report; I haven't finished it yet.
Our neighbours ___ a loud party when the police arrived.
items.why: Вечеринка уже шла, когда пришла полиция — **were having**.

options: I was knowing her at school.
items.why: Know — глагол состояния, continuous не нужен.

options: He was driving too fast when the police stopped him.
He drove too fast when the police were stopping him.
items.why: Длинное действие (езда) — continuous, короткое событие (остановка) — simple.

options: I was wearing my best suit when I spilled coffee over it.
I wore my best suit when I was spilling coffee over it.
She was always complaining when she worked there.
items.why: Always ставится после was: **was always complaining**.

options: I was seeing a strange light in the sky last night.
I saw a strange light in the sky last night.
items.why: Единичное событие — past simple; see в значении «увидеть» в continuous не используется.

options: The sun was shining and birds were singing when we set off.
The sun shone and birds sang when we were setting off.
items.why: Фон — past continuous, событие set off — past simple.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, используя past continuous и past simple.

items.prompt: (I / walk / home / when / it / start / to rain)
answers: I was walking home when it started to rain.

items.prompt: (the phone / ring / while / I / have / a shower)
answers: The phone rang while I was having a shower.

items.prompt: (the speaker / still / talk / when / the lights / go out)
answers: The speaker was still talking when the lights went out.

items.prompt: (we / watch / a film / when / the power / fail)
answers: We were watching a film when the power failed.

items.prompt: (when / I / see / him / he / wear / a uniform)
answers: When I saw him, he was wearing a uniform.
When I saw him he was wearing a uniform.

items.prompt: (what / you / do / when / the earthquake / happen?)
answers: What were you doing when the earthquake happened?

items.prompt: (I / cross / the road / when / I / hear / a scream)
answers: I was crossing the road when I heard a scream.

exercises.title: Сделайте мягче или эмоциональнее
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение по заданию в скобках, используя past continuous.

items.prompt: I wonder if you could help me. (вежливо)
answers: I was wondering if you could help me.

items.prompt: I hope you can come to dinner. (вежливо)
answers: I was hoping you could come to dinner.
I was hoping that you could come to dinner.
I was thinking we should leave.
I was thinking that we should leave.

items.prompt: He lost his keys all the time. (always, раздражение)
answers: He was always losing his keys.

items.prompt: Our flight to Oslo was the next day. (fly, план)
answers: We were flying to Oslo the next day.

items.prompt: I thought of calling you earlier. (think, процесс)
answers: I was thinking of calling you earlier.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, используя past simple и past continuous.

items.prompt: What were you doing at 8 p.m. yesterday?
items.sample: I was cooking dinner and listening to a podcast.

items.prompt: Describe a time when something unexpected happened while you were doing something ordinary.
items.sample: I was walking to work when I found a wallet on the pavement. I took it to the police.

items.prompt: Describe the weather and the scene the last time you were on holiday.
items.sample: The sun was shining and children were playing on the beach when we arrived.

items.prompt: Think of someone from your past who was always doing something annoying.
items.sample: My roommate was always borrowing my books and never returning them.

items.prompt: Write a polite request to a teacher using I was wondering.
items.sample: I was wondering if I could hand in my essay on Friday instead of Thursday.
